title: RouterDecision Contract (v1)
description: Phase 28.A-0 / ADR-020 (APPROVED). The ONLY output of the deterministic Router: validated IntentResult -> declared Agent. The Router does lookup / validate / dispatch and NOTHING else — no insurance business logic, no workflow knowledge, no knowledge retrieval, no product recommendation. An LLM may NEVER produce a RouterDecision: decision_source has no LLM value (structural exclusion) and any LLM-produced document claiming to be a routing decision is by contract invalid. agent_id MUST reference an Agent declared in the Agent Registry (checked against the registry document by contract tests and, at implementation time, by the router's registry-only import boundary + CI tests).

intent_id.description: Echo of the consumed IntentResult.intent_id (same v1 vocabulary). The Router consumes ONLY schema-validated IntentResults.

agent_id.description: Target agent, MUST exist in the Agent Registry (single source of truth, ADR-021). fail-closed: unknown intent or missing agent routes to the conversation agent's clarification path (decision_source=fallback), never a business agent by default.

decision_source.description: registry_lookup = table hit intent->declared agent; fallback = clarification path (unknown intent / low-confidence high-risk / unclassifiable); blocked = routing refused by a gate (e.g. data policy). Deliberately NO 'llm' value: the Router is deterministic, LLM never decides routing (ADR-020 forbidden list).

valid.description: Whether the consumed IntentResult passed schema validation. false must pair with decision_source=fallback or blocked.

intent_result_created_at.description: Traceability back to the IntentResult decision timestamp.
